battle.name: 饒鳳關之戰
battle.brief: 紹興三年，宋廷命吳玠收復秦鳳，金人為阻西進，在關中西部鳳翔府東面的饒鳳關同宋軍對峙。此役決勝的不是火器：銅管唧筒推送易燃油料的希臘火是七世紀拜占庭的機密配方，宋金兩軍皆無此物，關中仍靠神臂弓、床子弩與隘口取勝。金兵糧道拉長、關中空乏，宋軍據關固守，終保住收復秦州、鳳翔的成果。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是南宋與金朝，戰場在陝西關中西部秦鳳路的東段。一一三三年是宋高宗紹興三年，金朝皇帝為熙宗完顏亶，完顏亮尚未稱帝、仍是握兵柄的宗室，金廷樞密院在燕京一線調度西北與中原兩路兵馬，完顏宗弼（兀朮）以西線統帥之任出入河東、陝西，完顏昌（宋）以左副元帥坐鎮燕京，與西線相策應。南宋方面，川陝一線由川陝宣撫司與陝西六路安撫司分節，吳玠以川陝宣撫副使兼節制陝西六路軍馬坐鎮興元，其弟吳璘任興元軍統制，楊政為川陝副都統；各路另有知州、通判、軍將與寨兵。金軍以猛安謀克與重甲騎兵為骨幹，漢軍、契丹軍編入漢軍都統府，金廷在關中設陝西統軍司與招討司，按戶籍徵糧、括民為役，並強遷漢戶入關充實新附之地；宋軍則以禁軍步軍與弓弩手為主，輔以各縣弓手、寨兵與新募民兵，糧秣自興元沿褒斜、陳倉兩道北運。這場戰爭的地理框架因此十分清楚：一方是自河東、燕雲南下的女真騎兵，另一方是自四川、襄漢北上、以漢地老兵為骨幹的川陝防軍。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Southern Song and the Jin dynasty, and the fighting took place in the eastern half of the Qinfeng circuit in the western part of Guanzhong, Shaanxi. The year 1133 was the third year of the Shaoxing era under Emperor Gaozong of Song; the Jin emperor was the Jurchen Wanyan Dandan, Wanyan Liang had not yet taken the throne and was still a prince with troops in his hands, and the Jin Privy Council at Yanjing coordinated both the northwestern and the central fronts, with Wanyan Zongbi (Wuzhu) commanding the western line between Hedong and Shaanxi and Wanyan Chang (Song) seated at Yanjing as deputy commander-in-chief to support him. On the Song side the Sichuan-Shaanxi front was divided between the Sichuan-Shaanxi Pacification Office and the pacification offices of the six circuits of Shaanxi: Wu Jie, deputy pacification commissioner for Sichuan-Shaanxi and commander of the armies of the six Shaanxi circuits, held Xingyuan, his younger brother Wu Lin was commander of the Xingyuan army, and Yang Zheng was deputy commander of Sichuan-Shaanxi, while every circuit also had its prefects, sub-prefects, army commanders and village garrisons. The backbone of the Jin army was the meng'an mouke and their armoured cavalry, with Han and Khitan units folded into the Han commands; the Jin court opened a Shaanxi Army Command Office and pacification offices in Guanzhong, levied grain and corvée by household register, and forcibly moved Han families into the occupied districts in order to stock them. The Song fielded imperial infantry and crossbowmen as their main strength, supported by county archers, village garrisons and newly raised militia, and drew their grain north from Xingyuan along the Bao and Chencang roads. The shape of the war is therefore clear: on one side Jurchen cavalry advancing out of Hedong and Yanyun, on the other a Sichuan-Shaanxi defence built of Han troops raised in the south and garrisoned in the north.
people: 關鍵人物集中在宋廷的川陝兩方與金廷的西線。吳玠是這一局面的主導者：他接下曲端留下的關中防務之後，便不再尋求平原上的決戰，而以修築堡寨、扼守山隘、營田屯糧為務；紹興三年奉詔收復秦鳳，先取秦州、再圖鳳翔，所用的辦法始終是先立寨、儲糧、待敵於隘。吳璘是吳玠之弟，時任興元軍統制，統軍出興元西進，主持秦鳳一線的野戰與據點爭奪，他所部是宋軍在關中唯一能與金人騎兵在開闊地周旋的機動兵。楊政以川陝副都統鎮興元，主管糧運與後方整飭，與吳玠在調兵與分權上屢有齟齬，兩人之間的不和，是這一役之後頗多煩惱的來源。金方主持西線者是完顏宗弼，他自建炎末年起屢叩關中，熟稔河東、秦鳳之間的山道與渡口；完顏昌以左副元帥坐鎮燕京，負責整體攻勢的收放；熙宗完顏亶在燕京行臺對西線每一次進退都要批答。宋廷方面，高宗在建炎以來一直把川陝當作立國的根本，秦檜一輩主和之臣在朝中推議和戎，使收復秦鳳之役始終夾在「要不要再深入」的爭議之中；吳玠幕府中襄贊軍略者多為關中本地士人，熟悉山川道路與民間情形，這份熟悉是這一役看不見卻吃重的助力。
peopleEn: The decisive figures were concentrated on the Song's Sichuan-Shaanxi side and in the Jin western command. Wu Jie was the man who shaped the situation: after inheriting the Guanzhong defence from Qu Duan he never sought a set-piece battle on the plain again, and made it his business to build stockades, hold the passes and grow grain on military farms; in the third year of Shaoxing he was ordered to recover Qinfeng, taking Qinzhou first and Fengxiang next, and his method was always the same - plant a fort, store the grain, and wait for the enemy at the defile. Wu Lin, Wu Jie's younger brother, was at that moment commander of the Xingyuan army; he led the columns out of Xingyuan westward and conducted the field fighting and the contest for the strongpoints along the Qinfeng axis, and his troops were the only mobile body the Song had in Guanzhong able to manoeuvre against Jin cavalry in the open. Yang Zheng, deputy commander of Sichuan-Shaanxi, held Xingyuan and was responsible for grain convoy and rear administration, and he and Wu Jie quarrelled repeatedly over the movement of troops and the division of command, a friction that caused much trouble afterwards. On the Jin side the western line was run by Wanyan Zongbi, who had been knocking at the gates of Guanzhong since the end of the Jianyan era and knew the mountain tracks and fords between Hedong and Qinfeng; Wanyan Chang sat at Yanjing as deputy commander-in-chief, deciding when the general offensive was to be pressed and when folded up; and the Jin emperor Wanyan Dandan in the Yanjing headquarters had to approve every advance and withdrawal on the western front. In the Song court Gaozong had treated Sichuan and Shaanxi as the foundation of the state since the Jianyan era, while Qin Hui and the advocates of peace pushed for negotiations at court, so the campaign to recover Qinfeng was carried out under constant debate about whether to advance further; the staff who advised Wu Jie were largely men from Guanzhong itself, familiar with the hills, the roads and the local population, and that familiarity was a hidden weight in this campaign.
kits: 本卡的兵器是希臘火。希臘火是七世紀中葉拜占庭帝國的機密裝置：把以石油為基底的燃燒劑灌入銅管或青銅虹吸管，管後以唧筒加壓推送，液體被擠出後遇水即燃，會順著海面或牆面流淌，並粘附在被擊中的人與器械上。文字記載最早見於六七八年君士坦丁四世守君士坦丁堡、對抗阿拉伯軍之役，其後沿地中海用到十二世紀，克里米亞與君士坦丁堡的戰役都還有它的影子；配方從未外傳，後人只說它隨海船一同沉沒，連同秘密一起消失。希臘火真正的戰場是艦船與攻城營壘，因此歸在「land」一層，實際發射時多固定在陣位上：一具銅管、兩三名泵手、一段水線，便可在城頭或壕壘外側張出一道無法撲滅的火幕。但一一三三年的關中沒有這套東西，兩軍都沒有。與它同一時期存在於中國的，是《武經總要》所載的猛火油櫃、毒煙、火箭與震天雷：猛火油櫃以銅管盛油、用唧筒推送，能燒掉城下的攻城塔與水上的船板；毒煙以藥草與砒霜一類的東西填於罐中，隨風散入敵陣；火箭與震天雷負責引火與破壞。這些器械與希臘火共享「把火變成投射物」的念頭，機理卻不同：希臘火靠壓送與遇水自燃，中國的猛火油靠澆灑與點火，兩條路數從未交匯。關中真正決定勝負的裝備仍是弩與砲：宋軍備神臂弓、床子弩、臂弩、步弓、長槍與大盾，金軍備札甲重騎、鐵馬、撞竿、雲梯、穴地與飛石攻城；就射程、射速與消耗而言，這場戰爭的勝負早在出發之前便已被算定。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is Greek fire. Greek fire was a secret device of the Byzantine empire in the middle of the seventh century: a burning mixture based on petroleum was poured into a copper or bronze siphon, and a pump behind it forced the liquid out, so that the stream ignited on contact with water, ran along the surface of the sea or the face of a wall, and clung to the men and the machines it struck. The earliest written notice dates from 678, when Constantine IV defended Constantinople against an Arab army, and it was used along the Mediterranean for the five centuries that followed, appearing again at the sieges of Constantinople and in the Crimea; the formula never escaped, and later writers said only that it went down with the ships, secret and all. The true battlefield of Greek fire was the warship and the siege camp, which is why the weapon is classed as a land device: in action it was usually emplaced in a fixed position, and one bronze tube, two or three pump men and a supply of water could throw a sheet of fire that could not be smothered from the wall-head or from the ditch. None of this existed in Guanzhong in 1133, on either side. What China had at the same time was recorded in the Wujing Zongyao: the menghuoyou oil chest, poison smoke, fire arrows and the thunder-crash bomb. The oil chest carried burning oil in a copper pipe and pushed it with a pump, so that it could set alight the siege towers below a wall and the planking of boats on the water; poison smoke was packed into jars with herbs and arsenic-like substances and drifted downwind into the enemy ranks; fire arrows and the thunder-crash bomb were responsible for ignition and destruction. These devices share with Greek fire the idea of turning fire into a projectile, but their mechanism differs: Greek fire relies on pumping and on self-ignition at water, Chinese burning oil on pouring and on lighting, and the two lines never met. What actually decided the matter in Guanzhong was still the crossbow and the artillery: the Song had the shenbi gong, bed-nu and hand crossbows, ordinary bows, spears and large shields, while the Jin had armoured heavy cavalry, warhorses, battering beams, scaling ladders, mining and stone-throwing engines. As for range, rate of fire and consumption, the outcome of this war had been calculated long before the armies marched.
tactics: 關中西部自唐末以來已開成一大片可以縱騎馳騁的平原，鐵騎一旦展開，步卒就難以支撐，吳玠的辦法因此是不爭平原而爭隘口。饒鳳關一線的地形是：關東連京兆府境內的渭北通道，關西通往鳳翔府與秦州，道路夾在渭北黃土高原與隴山餘脈之間，車馬能過，兵陣卻攤不開。金軍的攻城辦法是先以騎兵越關、貼住關牆，再用穴地與搭鈎同時壓上，逼守軍離開射界；宋軍的應對是據關不戰，把主力放在關後坡地的堡寨之間，以床子弩與神臂弓封住通道，槍兵結陣擋住馬蹄，弓弩手只在金騎進入射程時才放箭。金軍若攻不下，就退保關外數十里的營壘，繼續以遊騎斷宋軍的糧道與援兵。宋軍的糧道自興元沿褒斜、陳倉兩道北運，路遠而險，護送糧隊是全軍最吃重的差事；金軍在關中已過五年，掠地而無糧，關內民戶凋敝，攻關之後還得在饒鳳關一線取得糧秣才站得住腳，這正是吳玠寧可固守關隘、逐步恢復屯田，也不肯在平原上決戰的緣由。旗鼓傳訊、夜襲焚燒攻城器械、白日以長弓與弩交替壓制的循環，是雙方都曾用過的老法子；此役的差別只在誰能先把弓弩的射界佈滿在關前的斜坡上。
tacticsEn: The western part of Guanzhong had been opened out into a broad plain on which cavalry could sweep at full stretch since the late Tang, and once the iron horse had room to deploy, foot soldiers could not hold. Wu Jie's answer was therefore to contest the defiles rather than the plain. The ground around Raofeng Pass was like this: to the east the pass joined the Weibei corridor inside Jingzhao prefecture, to the west the road led on to Fengxiang prefecture and Qinzhou, with the track hemmed in between the loess heights north of the Wei and the southern spurs of the Long Mountains, passable for carts and horses but no place to deploy a formation. The Jin method was to send cavalry over the pass to hug the wall, and then to press with mining and hooked ropes at the same moment, driving the defenders out of their firing line. The Song answer was to hold the pass and not to fight for it, keeping the main strength among the stockades on the slopes behind the pass, sealing the road with bed-nu and shenbi gong, forming spearmen in rank to stop the horses, and letting the archers loose only when Jin cavalry came within range. When an assault failed, the Jin retired to camp a few tens of li outside the pass and went on cutting the Song supply road and relieving columns with raiding parties. The Song grain road ran north from Xingyuan by the Bao and Chencang tracks, long and dangerous, and escorting the convoys was the heaviest duty in the army. The Jin had already spent five years in Guanzhong, taking land without grain, and the districts inside the pass were worn out; after taking a pass they still had to bring food and fodder to the line of Raofeng before they could stand there at all, which is exactly why Wu Jie preferred to hold his defiles and slowly restore his farms rather than risk a battle in the open. Flag and drum signals, night sallies to burn the siege machines and alternating pressure from longbows and crossbows by day were the old routines both sides used; the difference in this campaign was only over who could first cover the slopes in front of the pass with the firing arcs of his bows.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但幾個節點相當確定。紹興三年宋廷下詔收復秦、鳳，戰事自春入冬，跨三、四月直到十一月；秦州與鳳翔府在這一年內先後歸宋，隨後設秦鳳路經略安撫司與鳳翔府路經略安撫司。金人攻饒鳳關的記載偏於「相持數月」一類的概略，具體出動兵力與陣亡數字正史多不載，後人推算的數目彼此矛盾，只能取其大概：金方西線在陝西的兵力以數萬計，其中一部分為騎兵，攻城時配砲與雲梯；宋方投入的是吳玠直屬的川軍主力，加上關中各處寨兵，總數不詳。距離上，興元至鳳翔隔著褒斜、陳倉兩條古道，各數百里，沿途有驛站、橋梁與關城；饒鳳關距鳳翔府數十里，是關中西進的門戶，而它的確切里數與方位，傳世記載只留下關名。可以確定的是，它位在鳳翔府東面的渭北通道上，今當陝西咸陽興平、武功一帶。武器參數方面，《武經總要》留下的數字可作參照：步弓有效射程約七十至一百步，弩約一百五十步，神臂弓記載可及二百步以上、更遠者傳聞三百步；弩的單兵射速低於弓，發射之後重新上弦往往要數息到數十息，這正是野戰中弩手最脆弱的時段。希臘火方面可確定的年代是六七年前後的發明、六七八年首次見於記載，其後直到十二世紀仍有銅管與唧筒操作的文字描述。
dataEn: Few of the figures can be checked, but several landmarks are solid. In the third year of Shaoxing the court ordered the recovery of Qin and Feng; the fighting ran from spring into winter, from the third and fourth months through to the eleventh, and Qinzhou and Fengxiang prefecture passed into Song hands within that year, after which the Pacification Office of the Qinfeng circuit and that of Fengxiang prefecture were established. The record of the Jin attack on Raofeng Pass is of the vague sort that says the two sides stood against each other for several months; the actual numbers of men engaged and of casualties are mostly absent from the official histories, and the figures later writers computed contradict one another, so only the rough shape can be kept: the Jin western force in Shaanxi numbered some tens of thousands, a part of them cavalry, with artillery and scaling ladders for the assault; the Song committed the main body of Wu Jie's Sichuan troops together with the village garrisons of Guanzhong, and the total is not known. As for distances, Xingyuan and Fengxiang are separated by the ancient tracks of Bao and Chencang, several hundred li each, with relay stations, bridges and fortified passes along the way; Raofeng Pass lies a few tens of li from Fengxiang prefecture and is the gateway west into Guanzhong, though its exact li count and bearing survive only as the name itself. What can be established is that it lay on the Weibei road east of Fengxiang prefecture, in what is now the Xingping-Wugong area of Xianyang, Shaanxi. For the weapons, the figures in the Wujing Zongyao serve as reference: the effective range of an ordinary bow was about seventy to a hundred paces, the crossbow about a hundred and fifty, and the shenbi gong is recorded as reaching beyond two hundred paces, with three hundred reported at the extreme; the individual rate of fire of a crossbow was below that of a bow, and re-cocking and re-loading after a shot took from several breaths to several tens of breaths, which was exactly the interval in which crossbowmen were most exposed in the open field. For Greek fire the dates that can be fixed are the invention around 670 and the first notice in 678, with descriptions of the bronze tube and the pump crew continuing down to the twelfth century.
cause: 打起來的起因有遠近兩層。近的一層是紹興二年之後宋廷在秦鳳的收復計畫。建炎以來關中失陷，金人據陝西五年，京兆、涇原、環慶諸州與熙河、洮岷一路盡在敵手，宋廷的西北漕運斷絕，蜀口與中原隔絕，吳玠在川陝只能以偏師拒守大散關、和尚原一線；只要陝西仍在金人手中，宋金在川陝的界線就永遠卡在大散關，蜀地始終暴露在金軍的側翼之下。於是紹興三年朝廷決定讓吳玠出兵收復秦鳳，把防線向前推到鳳翔、秦州一線，使關中西部重新成為屏障。遠的一層是金廷的西進計畫。金人不甘只守關中，完顏宗弼屢次由陝西南下直取蜀口，宋軍若在關中站穩，金軍任何一次西征都將失去側翼的支點；宋軍一旦收復秦鳳，關中的糧源、人丁與道路都會重新歸宋，金人在關中便站不住腳。所以秦州與鳳翔的爭奪，說到底是雙方在關中這塊地方上「由誰來耕、由誰來守」的爭奪：對宋廷是收復失地、補上漕運的一段斷路，對金人是保住退回河東的通道。
causeEn: The war had a near cause and a distant one. The near cause was the Song court's plan for Qinfeng after the second year of Shaoxing. Since the Jianyan era Guanzhong had been lost, the Jin had held Shaanxi for five years, Jingzhao, Jingyuan, Huanqing and the circuits of Xihe and Taomin were all in enemy hands, the northwestern grain traffic of the Song was cut, and Shu was cut off from the Central Plain; Wu Jie could hold nothing better than a line of detachments at Dasan Pass and Heshangyuan. As long as Shaanxi remained in Jin hands, the Song-Jin frontier on the Sichuan-Shaanxi line would stay pinned at Dasan Pass, and Shu would always be exposed on its flank. In the third year of Shaoxing the court therefore let Wu Jie advance to recover Qinfeng and push the line forward onto the axis of Fengxiang and Qinzhou, so that the western part of Guanzhong would once again be a shield. The distant cause was the Jin plan to advance west. The Jin were not content to sit in Guanzhong, Wanyan Zongbi had marched south out of Shaanxi toward the mouth of Shu more than once, and if the Song held firm in Guanzhong then every Jin western expedition would lose its pivot on the flank; once the Song had recovered Qinfeng, the grain, the people and the roads of Guanzhong would all return to Song hands and the Jin could not keep their footing there. So the contest for Qinzhou and Fengxiang was in the end a contest over who would farm and who would garrison this stretch of Guanzhong: for the Song the recovery of lost territory and the mending of a broken grain road, for the Jin the preservation of the road back to Hedong.
impact: 饒鳳關這一役的直接影響，是宋廷在關中西部重新站住了腳。紹興三年收復秦、鳳之後，宋在關中有了可以屯田的地盤，吳玠在秦鳳推行營田，募流民耕種、修渠堰陂，軍糧由仰給川峽轉為就地供給，川軍不必再為千里轉糧而分兵，這是「以陝蜀為根本」的策略第一次落到實處。技術上，這條戰線把弩砲對鐵騎的守禦模式磨到成熟：宋軍在隘口以神臂弓與床子弩分層射擊，金軍騎兵衝不開，只能改以穴地、雲梯與撞竿硬攻城牆，攻守的尺度、彈藥的儲存與士氣的消耗都變成可以估算的東西，這些經驗後來被寫進軍書。火器的對照也值得記下：拜占庭的希臘火以銅管唧筒推送易燃油料，配方是帝國的機密，配方與船一同沉沒；中國在同一時期已有《武經總要》所載的猛火油櫃、毒煙、火箭與震天雷，能燒、能爆，卻是拋擲與澆灑而不是壓送。一二世紀的歐亞兩端，同時出現了把火變成投射物的念頭，而真正把它系統化的，是地中海的艦船與修院抄本。關中這條戰線沒有改變任何一方的技術路徑，卻把宋金邊界在關中這一段定下來，直到紹興和議。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the fighting at Raofeng Pass was that the Song court got its footing back in the western part of Guanzhong. With Qin and Feng recovered in the third year of Shaoxing, the Song again had land in Guanzhong on which to farm; Wu Jie promoted military farms in Qinfeng, enlisted refugees to till the fields and repaired canals and weirs, and the grain of the army changed from being supplied at long range out of Sichuan to being produced on the spot, so that the Sichuan army no longer had to be split up in order to move supplies a thousand li. This was the first time the policy of making Shaanxi and Shu the foundation of the state had been put into actual practice. Technologically, this front worked the defensive pattern of crossbow and artillery against armoured horse to a finished state: the Song shot in layers from the defiles with shenbi gong and bed-nu, the Jin cavalry could not force the line, and they had to fall back on mining, scaling ladders and battering beams against the wall, so that the scale of attack and defence, the storage of ammunition and the wearing of morale all became things that could be reckoned with, and these lessons were later written into the military manuals. The contrast in fire weapons is worth recording as well: Byzantine Greek fire pushed inflammable fuel through a bronze tube and a pump, and the formula was an imperial secret that went down with the ships; China at the same time already had the menghuoyou oil chest, poison smoke, fire arrows and the thunder-crash bomb, which could burn and could burst, but worked by throwing and pouring rather than by pumping. At both ends of Eurasia in the twelfth century the idea of turning fire into a projectile appeared at once, and the one that made it systematic was the warship and the monastery scriptorium of the Mediterranean. This front in Guanzhong changed no one's technological path, but it fixed the Song-Jin boundary on this section of Guanzhong until the Shaoxing settlement.
result: 就一一三三年這一季而言，結果是宋軍守住了關中西部：饒鳳關一線沒有被金軍突破，秦州、鳳翔兩州入宋，宋廷隨即設秦鳳路經略安撫司與鳳翔府路經略安撫司，把新收之地編入常設的行政與軍防體系，吳玠留鎮興元，吳璘守大散關、和尚原一線。與此同時，金軍在關中的攻勢就此中止：關中已空，糧道自河東與渭水運來既慢又險，攻關之後無力東進，只得以突騎窺擾而退；宋軍則在關內恢復屯田、收容流亡，把防線從被動挨打改成據險待敵。紹興四年正月金人再攻和尚原，吳璘移軍先據仙人關，兩軍在關前相持，金軍糧盡退回，此即另一場戰役。以後五六年雙方在關中再無大戰，直到一一四一年紹興和議以淮水至大散關劃界，關中兩側秦鳳歸宋、京兆涇原環慶歸金，這場戰爭的結局才算正式落定；而饒鳳關這個地名，也隨著秦鳳路的建立留在了西北邊防的地名錄上。
resultEn: For the campaigning season of 1133 the result was that the Song held the western part of Guanzhong: the line at Raofeng Pass was not broken through, Qinzhou and Fengxiang prefecture came to the Song, and the court immediately set up the Pacification Office of the Qinfeng circuit and that of Fengxiang prefecture, bringing the newly taken ground into a permanent administrative and military structure, with Wu Jie remaining at Xingyuan and Wu Lin holding the Dasan Pass and Heshangyuan line. At the same time the Jin offensive in Guanzhong came to an end: the region was empty, grain coming up from Hedong and along the Wei was slow and risky, and after taking a pass they had no strength to drive east, so they withdrew after raiding with light horse; the Song, for their part, restored their farms inside the pass, took in the displaced population, and changed the line from passive endurance into waiting on the heights. In the first month of the fourth year of Shaoxing the Jin attacked Heshangyuan again; Wu Lin moved his troops to take up position at Xianrenguan first, the two armies stood against each other before the pass, and the Jin withdrew for want of grain, which was the separate battle known by its own name. For five or six years afterwards there was no large engagement in Guanzhong, and only with the Shaoxing settlement of 1141, drawing the frontier from the Huai to Dasan Pass and leaving Qinfeng with the Song while Jingzhao, Jingyuan and Huanqing stayed with the Jin, was the outcome of this war formally settled. The name Raofeng Pass, for its part, stayed on the roll of place names on the northwestern frontier for as long as the Qinfeng circuit existed.
